blb.text: Cruelclaw is a scarred weaselfolk mercenary who starts out filching raccoonfolk heirlooms and moves on to bigger jobs for nastier clients, until King Glarb hires him to steal Maha's egg.
Coffey shows Mabel's party an image of Cruelclaw leading his band through the swamp and reveals that he stole a Calamity Beast egg, which may give him power over the beasts.
In Fountainport the party finds the egg, which King Glarb says he paid Cruelclaw extremely well to bring, and Glarb orders Cruelclaw's Direshades to kill them.
Helga sends Cruelclaw sliding into the king to break their bonds, and Mabel disarms him and spares his life, telling him to leave, so he escapes as Glarb flees the city.
